name: Phase 5E Graph and Network Intelligence Audit Findings

findings.description: Message passing direction reversal in sparse matrix multiplication. Stacked [row, col] = [source, target] caused source nodes to aggregate target features instead of target nodes aggregating incoming source features.
NetworkX DiGraph initialization clobbered parallel corporate edges between the same entity pair. Adding a director relationship erased prior 50% ownership edges, causing beneficial owners to be lost.
Global adjacency reassignment (self._adjacency = defaultdict(set)) inside get_subgraph wiped out the entire graph's adjacency structure for subsequent callers.
Temporal point-in-time traversal was missing as_of parameters, allowing future edges to leak into neighbor discovery, subgraph boundaries, cycle detection, and GNN tensors (violating Gate N).
Naive ISO-8601 strings subtracted from aware datetime.now(UTC) raised TypeError, which was silently swallowed, zeroing out node age and recency features.
Graph embedding service lacked explicit cache invalidation mechanisms and finite tensor assertions, allowing mutated graphs to serve stale representations and potential NaNs to propagate.
Cypher query for multi-hop neighbor search returned root entity in cyclic paths of length >= 2.
findings.verification_test: Cypher query updated with WHERE n.id <> $entity_id
